claims.description: District-level GP Maths Contest accuracy (grades 4-6, 2022-25) correlates with SSLC 2025 Class-10 mathematics pass% at Spearman rho = +0.57 across 31 districts, indicating the same districts lag in maths from primary school through the Class-10 board.

A single standardized development index (female ever-schooled, improved sanitation, women with 10+ years schooling) explains R2 = 0.43 of the between-district variation in contest maths accuracy in an OLS benchmark over 31 districts.

Some districts under-perform their development-context benchmark (e.g. chitradurga by ~12.8 percentage points), marking them as school-side, rather than purely developmental, intervention priorities. Which residual-gap districts to prioritise and why is a policy judgement, not a single number.

verification_detail.reasoning: The residual gap in outputs/predictions/predictions.csv is computed programmatically, but ranking districts for intervention and attributing the gap to school-side factors requires domain judgement the pipeline cannot make.
